name: Google Ads 4 — Offline Revenue Upload (Lead Sheet → Ads)

parameters.content:
## Offline Revenue → ROAS
The office fills in the **Leads** tab (one row per lead per stage). Each night this sends gclid + stage + revenue to Google Ads, then stamps the row so it is never sent twice.

Columns: `row_id | gclid | gbraid | stage | stage_date | revenue | uploaded_at | upload_status`
